text:
ada: Observed spike of mTLS decrypt errors in eu-north-1 after merging iam/infra#891 — ~1.8% handshakes failing with "tls: decryption failed".
lin: tagging @tom. Did the PR change KMS resource ARNs?
tom: yes I consolidated bindings and used arn:aws:kms:eu-*:*:key/* for region convenience. Rolling back now.
security-bot: KMS_DENY event: principal=svc-edge-prod action=Decrypt key=arn:aws:kms:eu-north-1:999:key/fee1-dead error=AccessDenied ts=2025-06-11T08:12:34Z
ada: Mitigation: revert wildcard -> explicit ARN, route to regional fallback key, disable 0-RTT on eu-edge for 20m.
lin: Followups: add CI lint to reject KMS wildcards for HSM-type keys, alert tls_decrypt_errors{region=~"eu.*"} > 3/min, extend KMS audit retention to 90d for affected keys.
tom: I'll open the PRs and the postmortem. No PLAINTEXT leaked; marking Sev3 availability impact.
